subject: Valet staging & ridepool playbook — Downtown workshop (May 15)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Valet staging + ridepool for May 15 downtown workshop

Hi team,

We're finalizing logistics for Acme's onsite workshop on May 15 (downtown conference center). Can you lead the ground transport plan? Key asks:
- Valet staging footprint (short-term parking, overflow, vendor check-in). I've attached the venue map.
- Shared-ride grouping windows and an option for a dedicated executive car service for three C-levels.
- Estimated headcount per arrival window and quick ETA buffers for speakers (they're arriving 08:15–09:00).

Please draft a short playbook with vendor contacts and a pickup manifest template by EOD Monday. I've looped Marissa for attendee pickup coordination.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Programs, Redwood Inference

Attachment: venue_map.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Valet staging + ridepool for May 15 downtown workshop

Thanks Laura — draft below. Attaching a quick valet layout and our current rate comp. This is a working playbook; happy to iterate after vendor responses.

Playbook (high level)
1) Valet staging & flow
   - Primary staging: curb lane A (north side) — 6 lanes for drop-off, 2 dedicated for executive escort vehicles.
   - Overflow staging lot B (2 blocks east) with shuttle loop (10-min cycle).
   - Vendor check-in: Gate 3 (west entrance) — CityValet will staff 07:00–11:30.

2) Ridepool windows (by badge group)
   - 08:00–08:20: Speakers + execs (priority escort)
   - 08:20–08:50: Attendees group A (bulk shuttles & pooled rides)
   - 08:50–09:20: Attendees group B + late arrivals

3) Executive cars
   - Recommend Shoreline Car for 3 execs (black sedans, separate billing). They confirmed availability for May 15 (see their note below).

4) Parking & permits
   - Short-term curb permits for staging lane A — Facilities to request via city permit (I started the form).

5) Onsite staffing
   - 4 valet leads (2 gates), 2 walkie comms, 1 staging supervisor. CityValet ops will share staff roster.

6) Contingencies
   - If street closure reduces lanes, divert overflow to lot B and open an additional shuttle (pre-booked 15-pass vans).

Next steps
- Marissa: can you confirm final headcount and three exec names for dedicated cars?
- I'll send RFQ to Shoreline + CityValet this afternoon and consolidate final manifest.

So references attached: valet_layout_v2.png, fleet_rates.xlsx

Soojin Lee
Events Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@shorelinecars.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: CityValet Ops <ops@cityvalet.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Valet staging + ridepool for May 15 downtown workshop

Hi Soojin — thanks for the heads-up. Shoreline can cover the 3 executive trips and provide a small fleet for overflow concierge runs. Pricing & capacity below (summary):
- 3 black sedans (exec class): $95/hr/vehicle (minimum 4 hrs) — includes meet & greet and priority escort.
- Shuttle car (12-pass): $55/hr (for last-mile loops between lot B and venue).
- Onsite concierge (2 staff): $60/hr each (vehicle staging and guest escort).

We can pre-stage 2 sedans at 07:15 and hold a third on standby until 09:00. We will provide a signed company certificate and driver IDs; attaching our confirmation PDF. We can accept consolidated liability terms from Redwood or work with Acme's procurement options.

Attachment: shoreline_confirmation.pdf

Let me know if you want us to quote for covered waiting (weather) and luggage handling.

Best,
Alex Rodriguez
Regional Ops, Shoreline Car Service
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Valet staging + ridepool for May 15 downtown workshop

Perfect — I'm attaching the draft guest pickup manifest (we'll finalize names by next Wed). Quick notes:
- Execs: Priya Sharma (Acme CEO), Daniel Ortiz (CPO), Mei Chen (CTO). Priya needs a 07:40 pickup from airport hotel (Townsend Suites).
- Group A (VIP partners) ~ 28 folks arriving between 08:10–08:35; prefer pooled rides (3 shuttle cycles).
- Group B ~ 120 attendees arriving in staggered waves.

Link to live manifest: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1c-manifest-draft

Could we have Shoreline confirm pickup window for Priya so we can block the sedan? Also, please include permit contact — I pinged Facilities but haven't received confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa
Program Coordinator, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pickup_manifest_final.csv (placeholder — final will be updated after names)

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming plan and approvals:
- Shoreline: please block one sedan for Priya Sharma (07:30 pickup window, meet-and-greet at Townsend Suites). The second sedan is pre-staged at 07:15.
- CityValet: staging lanes and Gate 3 staffing approved; please provide final staff roster by May 8.
- Facilities: permit request submitted; if there's an issue we'll escalate to Ops.

Soojin — please produce the final two-page playbook (printable: staging map + pick-up windows + vendor contacts + emergency contact sheet) and share the Drive link. Marissa — finalize attendee list and send the CSV by May 6 so we can share manifests with vendors.

I copied Alex so Shoreline can accept the pickup window; once we have signed confirmation we'll proceed with billing instructions.

Thanks,
Laura
